title: Modernist Residence
shortDescription: A minimalist family home embracing natural light and open spaces.
description: This residential project explores the relationship between indoor and outdoor living. Floor-to-ceiling windows blur the boundaries between the interior and the surrounding landscape. The design prioritizes natural materials and sustainable construction methods.

title: Urban Cultural Center
shortDescription: A community hub featuring exhibition spaces and a performance theater.
description: The Urban Cultural Center serves as a gathering place for arts and culture. The building's geometric facade reflects the city's dynamic character while providing optimal natural lighting for gallery spaces.

title: Green Office Complex
shortDescription: LEED Platinum certified workspace integrating biophilic design principles.
description: A forward-thinking office complex designed for collaboration and employee wellbeing. Green roofs, natural ventilation, and integrated plant walls create a healthy work environment while minimizing the building's carbon footprint.

title: Mountain Retreat Lodge
shortDescription: A luxury eco-lodge harmonizing with alpine surroundings.
description: Perched on a mountainside, this retreat blends seamlessly into its dramatic environment. Local stone and timber construction, combined with passive solar design, create a comfortable haven that respects the natural landscape.

title: Riverside Mixed-Use Development
shortDescription: Waterfront apartments with retail spaces and public promenades.
description: This mixed-use development transforms an industrial waterfront into a vibrant community. The design celebrates the site's maritime history while providing modern living spaces with stunning river views.
